description: Source code for WorkerManager class, responsible for initializing and managing worker threads, executors, and related resources in a radio communication system. Includes methods for creating worker pools, support strands, and specific executors for different radio and protocol layers.

classes.name: thread_resource_preinitializer
classes.description: Observer class that preinitializes thread-local byte buffer pools and timers to optimize thread startup.

classes.name: pcap_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation of pcap executor mapper, managing different executor strands for protocol layers based on configuration.

methods.name: worker_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker manager, creating main worker pool, support strands, and specific executors based on configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all worker threads and executors gracefully.

methods.name: create_worker_pool
methods.description: Creates a worker thread pool with specified parameters and adds it to the execution manager.

methods.name: create_prio_worker
methods.description: Creates a prioritized worker thread with specific affinity and scheduling parameters.

methods.name: add_pcap_strands
methods.description: Sets up strands for PCAP writing based on configuration.

methods.name: create_cu_cp_executors
methods.description: Creates executor mapper for CU-CP components.

methods.name: create_cu_up_executors
methods.description: Creates executor mapper for CU-UP components with optional metrics channel.

methods.name: create_du_high_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for high-level DU tasks.

methods.name: create_du_low_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for low-level DU tasks, with different configurations for sequential or RF modes.

methods.name: create_ofh_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for Open Fronthaul message transmission and reception, including timing and TX/RX executors.

methods.name: create_split6_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for split6 protocol layer, including control and data strands.

methods.name: create_lower_phy_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for lower PHY layer, including different profiles for sequential, single, dual, and triple baseband processing.

methods.name: create_ru_dummy_executors
methods.description: Creates dummy executor for RU simulation or testing.
